pyramiding_rule: Strict freeze on position additions unless base order is floating at >= +2.0 ATR profit with stop-loss locked at Breakeven+1.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: XAUUSD orders require M5 ATR(14) > $1.80 and entry price distance >= $2.50 away from key session high/low boundaries.
profit_harvest_threshold: Harvest 40% partial profit at +1.5R ($3.00+ profit per 0.01 lot) and trail remaining volume via 1.2x ATR dynamic trailing stop.
